text: AirChess puts a full-size chess set on any table, desk, or floor. Walk around it. Lean in. It stays right where you put it.
Tap a piece and its moves light up. Tap a square and it glides there.
If you're stuck, tap Hint. Stockfish, one of the strongest chess engines ever built, draws its best move right across the board, and shows you what's under attack.
Want a challenge? Pick a side, pick a level, and take on the computer. If you've made a mistake, you can undo it and try again.
Chess is better with a friend. Create a game, share the code, and they're in, from anywhere.
You each play on your own table, from your own side of the board, live, with real clocks.
And with Share view, you see their board exactly as they do. Their room, their table, their move.
Sharing is off until you turn it on, so nothing is recorded, and there's no microphone.
You can offer a draw or demand a rematch, and if you close the app mid-game, your game is waiting when you come back.
No phone handy? Play right in your browser, in 2D or 3D, against a friend or the computer.
